patches.title: Edge-to-edge window
patches.detail: Remove the window's frame border so the page meets the window's edges.

patches.title: Square window corners
patches.detail: Square Dia's rounded UI corners around the page and clip page corners.

patches.title: Hide toolbar
patches.detail: Hide the toolbar row: the address field, navigation buttons and extensions. The window controls stay, and the page moves up into the space.

patches.title: Toolbar color
patches.detail: Make the toolbar transparent so the sidebar color or window backdrop material shows through.

patches.title: Reveal toolbar on hover
patches.detail: Reveals the toolbar when moving the pointer to the top edge of the window.

patches.title: Show toolbar with the sidebar
patches.detail: Keeps the toolbar showing when the sidebar is open.

patches.title: Show toolbar on new tab pages
patches.detail: Keeps the toolbar showing when viewing a new tab or start page.

patches.title: Always show address field
patches.detail: Keep the address field's bookmark and site buttons showing without hovering, with a subtle field background.

patches.title: Hide sidebar button
patches.detail: Hide the sidebar toggle at the top-left of the toolbar.

patches.title: Peek link preview
patches.detail: Hold on a link or click with modifier to preview it in a card without leaving the tab.

patches.title: Peek trigger
patches.detail: How a Peek opens: Shift+click, hold on a link, Ctrl+Shift+click, or Alt+click.

patches.title: Peek animation
patches.detail: How the card flies in and out: Genie, Ease In/Out, or Zoom.

patches.title: Hide window controls
patches.detail: Hide the minimize, maximize and close buttons in the title bar. Alt+F4 and the window menu still work.

patches.title: Hide Chat button
patches.detail: Hide the Chat button at the top-right of the toolbar.

patches.title: Hide Personalize button
patches.detail: Hide the Personalize button when Dia shows it in the toolbar.

patches.title: Hide upgrade banner
patches.detail: Hide the Chat usage and upgrade card under the command bar when Dia shows it.

patches.title: Hide tab search button
patches.detail: Hide the overflow / search tabs button in the window drag header.

patches.title: Profile emoji
patches.detail: Show an emoji in place of each space's dot in the space switcher. Choose them in Settings › Profiles.

patches.title: Sidebar grain
patches.detail: Add procedural tactile texture (sand, grain, denim, paper) behind the sidebar and tabs.

patches.title: Hide Chats button
patches.detail: Dia for Windows does not have a separate sidebar Chats button (macOS specific layout).

patches.title: Compact sidebar header
patches.detail: The Windows sidebar header uses a different layout and does not expose a separate row to trim.

patches.title: Hide recent tabs button
patches.detail: Dia for Windows does not have a separate recent tabs button in the sidebar.

patches.title: Pinned extensions shown
patches.detail: Show up to 6, 8, 10, 12 or 16 pinned extensions by the address bar instead of Dia's 4.

patches.title: Hide page loading animation
patches.detail: Hide the loading indicator line in the address bar.

patches.title: Hide pinned tab border
patches.detail: Remove the border outline around pinned tabs.

patches.title: Hide tab hover card
patches.detail: Stops the preview card from popping up when hovering over open or pinned tabs.

patches.title: Translucent sidebar
patches.detail: Make the sidebar translucent.

patches.title: Window material
patches.detail: Apply Mica, Mica Alt or Acrylic backdrop material behind the tabs and sidebar.

patches.title: Keep the display awake
patches.detail: Stop the screen from sleeping while Dia is open.

patches.title: Don't pop up downloads
patches.detail: Stops the downloads list from opening by itself for each download.

patches.title: Hide new tab logo
patches.detail: The new-tab logo is drawn inside Dia's page canvas rather than as an individual XAML element.

patches.title: Clean search box
patches.detail: Streamline the New Tab and Command Bar (Ctrl+L / Ctrl+T) into a clean single-line input.

patches.title: Daily painting wallpaper
patches.detail: Display the Daily Brief's painting of the day as the New Tab page wallpaper.

patches.title: Turn off AI
patches.detail: Dia's AI features are controlled inside the app rather than by one XAML surface. Hide Chat button removes the main AI entry point.

patches.title: Allow iCloud passkeys
patches.detail: Not available on Windows. Relays passkey requests to Apple Passwords (macOS-only).

patches.title: Allow iCloud Passwords
patches.detail: Not available on Windows. Bridges to Apple's iCloud Passwords extension (macOS-only).

patches.title: Developer Mode Toolbar
patches.detail: Adds a Developer Mode toggle to the site settings menu and the tab menu. Sites in developer mode get a marked tab in the sidebar and a developer toolbar with console, network, inspector, capture and extension tools.

patches.title: Developer mode for localhost
patches.detail: Treat localhost and 127.0.0.1 as being in developer mode, without switching each site on by hand.

patches.title: Hide link address
patches.detail: Hide the hover link URL preview bubble at the bottom corner of the window.

patches.title: Arc pinned tabs
patches.detail: On hover, a pinned tab that left its pinned page shows a minus to go back; one still on its page shows a close button. Matches Arc's pinned tab behaviour.

patches.title: Hide history suggestions
patches.detail: Keep pages you've visited and past searches out of address and command bar suggestions. Searching, Chat, search suggestions and open tabs still show.

patches.title: Patch Dia however it's opened
patches.detail: Keep tweaks active whenever Dia opens from any shortcut, pinned icon, or link.

patches.title: Force Segoe UI Variable font
patches.detail: Use Windows 11's Segoe UI Variable font for web pages and UI instead of system-ui.

patches.title: Noto emoji font
patches.detail: Draw emoji in Dia's interface with Noto instead of Segoe UI Emoji. Install Noto Color Emoji (or Noto Emoji) first; only elements that show an emoji are changed.

patches.title: Emoji font family
patches.detail: Which Noto family to stack in front of Dia's fonts: Noto Color Emoji for colour, or Noto Emoji for monochrome outlines.
